summary: @servicetitan/assist-utils 1.1.2 preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated math_init.js payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases for the installer's platform/arch into a temp directory, chmod +x's it, then invokes `execFileSync(bunPath, [join(D, 'math_init.js')])` — running a sibling file under a freshly downloaded alternate runtime rather than Node. The executed file math_init.js is a 727,680-byte single-line bundle bearing the `// @bun @bun-cjs` header, with obfuscator-style control flow: a shuffled constant string/number array (`n7gIxM`), a string-array rotator (`function WV8StW(MmgoCP,etDiOOB,JqTtnbZ){...MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift())...}`), and hex-mangled identifiers. math_init.js and setup.mjs sit at the tarball root, are unmentioned by the README/CHANGELOG, and are unrelated to the package's advertised purpose (React MFE host communication utilities, whose real compiled code lives in dist/). The alternate-runtime dropper shape evades Node-resolved install-time scanners, and the payload is opaque under standard analysis. Consistent with a compromised publish of an otherwise legitimate corporate-scoped package.
